targetedRestoreFix.diagnosis: A full schema-and-data dump into an empty target can insert a row referencing page_publications before that table is created because page and publication rows form a cyclic reference.
targetedRestoreFix.appliedPath: Apply the three checked-in migrations first, then restore the explicit 12-table data-only export through scripts/cloudflare/phase1-d1-workflow.mjs.
targetedRestoreFix.foreignKeyHandling: FK enforcement remained enabled. Wrangler data export's PRAGMA defer_foreign_keys=TRUE permits the cyclic row set to be inserted; PRAGMA foreign_key_check ran after restore and returned zero violations on both databases.
